seo.title: QRCraft
seo.description: Generate, style, and download high-quality QR codes without touching a backend.
seo.ogDescription: Generate, style, and download high-quality QR codes without touching a backend.
seo.twitterDescription: Generate, style, and download high-quality QR codes without touching a backend.

layout.headerSubtitle: No sign-up needed. Runs entirely in your browser.

hero.title: Sculpt standout QR codes
hero.subtitle: Paste your link, make it yours, download in seconds.

controls.correctionHint: Higher = survives damage and supports logos.
controls.correctionBelowRecommended: Lower reliability can make this code harder to scan. Highest is recommended.
controls.correctionTooltip: How much of the QR code can be covered or damaged and still scan. Low gives a compact code; Highest lets you overlay a logo at the cost of a denser pattern.
controls.logoErrorUrl: Could not load image from URL
controls.logoTransparencyHint: PNG or SVG works best for transparent logos
controls.wifiHiddenTooltip: Check this only if your network is hidden and doesn't appear in Wi-Fi scan results.
controls.wifiWepWarning: WEP is outdated and easily cracked. Use WPA/WPA2 if possible.
controls.wifiCorrectionHint: Printed codes scan best at Highest reliability.
controls.vcardNameHint: At least one name is required.
controls.vcardPhoneError: Enter a phone number using digits, e.g. +95 9 123 456 789
controls.vcardWebsiteError: Enter a valid website address, e.g. https://example.com
controls.vcardCorrectionHint: Contact QR codes are data-dense, so Highest reliability is recommended.
controls.emailCorrectionHint: Highest reliability recommended for email codes.
controls.emailModeHint: Scan to open a pre-addressed email draft.
controls.emailPayloadWarning: Long message body makes the QR harder to scan reliably. Keep it concise.
controls.smsNumberError: Enter a phone number using digits, e.g. +95 9 123 456 789
controls.smsModeHint: Scan to open a text message with the number and message ready to send.
controls.smsCorrectionHint: Set to Highest for the most reliable SMS scanning.
controls.smsPayloadWarning: Long message makes the QR harder to scan reliably. Keep it concise.
controls.telNumberError: Enter a phone number using digits, e.g. +95 9 123 456 789
controls.telCorrectionHint: Set to Highest for the most reliable scanning.
controls.phoneNoCountryCodeCaution: No country code yet. Add one (like +95) so it works reliably everywhere.
controls.geoModeHint: Scan to open this spot in a map app.
controls.geoCoordinateHelp: Don't know them? In Google Maps, right-click your spot and copy the coordinates.
controls.geoLocationError: Couldn't get your location. Enter coordinates manually, or check your browser's location permission.
controls.geoLocationUnsupported: Your browser doesn't support location. Enter coordinates manually.
controls.geoLatitudeError: Latitude must be a number between -90 and 90.
controls.geoLongitudeError: Longitude must be a number between -180 and 180.
controls.geoCorrectionHint: Set to Highest for the most reliable scanning.
controls.veventModeHint: Anyone who scans this code can add your event to their calendar. Times appear exactly as you set them here.
controls.veventNeedTitleHint: Add an event title to finish your QR code.
controls.veventNeedStartHint: Add a start date to finish your QR code.
controls.veventNeedBothHint: Add an event title and start date to finish your QR code.
controls.veventEndError: The end can't be before the start.
controls.veventPayloadWarning: This event holds a lot of text. Shorter details make the code easier to scan.
controls.veventCorrectionHint: Error correction is set to Highest so the event scans reliably.
controls.cryptoModeHint: Anyone who scans this code can pay you in crypto. Their wallet opens with your address ready.
controls.cryptoCorrectionHint: Error correction is set to Highest so the address scans reliably.
controls.cryptoAddressErrorBitcoin: That doesn't look like a Bitcoin address.
controls.cryptoAddressErrorEthereum: That doesn't look like an Ethereum address.
controls.cryptoAddressNeededHint: Add a wallet address to finish your QR code.
controls.cryptoAmountError: Enter an amount greater than zero.
controls.cryptoIrreversibleCaution: Crypto payments can't be reversed. Double-check the address before you share the code.
controls.cryptoPayloadWarning: This label makes the code dense. A shorter label scans more reliably.
controls.cryptoPreviewNoAmount: Wallets open ready to pay this address.
controls.frameHint: Wrap your code with a label like SCAN ME so people know to scan it.
controls.frameTextHint: Shown on the frame. Leave empty for no caption.
controls.frameColorLowContrast: This frame color blends into the background. Pick a more contrasting color so the frame stays visible.
controls.copyLinkHint: Anyone with the link sees your text and design (not your logo).
controls.downloadsDisabledHint: Add a link to enable downloads.
controls.patternFluidHint: Merges touching modules into flowing shapes.
controls.readabilityRiskBody: High density shapes may affect camera readability.
controls.contrastLowBody: {ratio} contrast may prevent scanners from reading the QR code. Try darkening your foreground or lightening your background.
controls.contrastInvertedBody: Light on dark may not be recognized by all scanners. Try swapping foreground and background colors.

scan.title: Scan a QR code
scan.subtitle: Upload an image or use your camera to read any QR code.
scan.dropzoneHint: or click to choose a file
scan.cameraHint: Point your camera at a QR code.
scan.errorNoCode: No QR code found in that image. Try a clearer picture.
scan.errorUnsupportedFile: That file isn't an image. Upload a PNG or JPG.
scan.errorFileTooLarge: That image is too large. Choose a file under 25 MB.
scan.errorCameraDenied: Camera access was blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, or upload an image instead.
scan.errorCameraUnsupported: Your browser can't open the camera here. Upload an image instead.
scan.errorDecodeFailed: Couldn't read that image. Try another file.

batch.title: Generate in bulk
batch.subtitle: Paste a list of links or text, one per line, and download every QR code as a single ZIP.
batch.inputPlaceholder:
https://example.com/menu
https://example.com/wifi
Any text works too
batch.emptyHint: Add one link or line of text per row to build a batch.
batch.truncatedWarning: That is over the limit. Only the first {max} codes will be generated.
batch.designNote: Every code uses your current colors, pattern, and frame.
batch.successStatus: Done. Your ZIP download should start automatically.
batch.successStatusLabels: Done. Your label sheet PDF download should start automatically.
batch.errorEmpty: Add at least one link or line of text first.
batch.errorRender: Something went wrong while generating. Please try again.
batch.importErrorEmpty: The file is empty or contains no usable rows.
batch.importErrorRead: Could not read the file. Please try again.
batch.csvMapHint: Pick the column to encode. Optionally name each file from another column.
batch.csvMapStructuredHint: Map each field to a column. Codes build from the mapped cells; rows missing a required field are skipped.
batch.csvStructuredPlaceholder: QR values are built from the columns you map below.

presets.emptyHint: Save your current design to reuse it with any code.
